==Biography==

===2017 Season===

Suning Gaming was formed in December of 2016 to participate in the LSPL and XiaoAL joined the team. In the [[LSPL/2017_Season/Spring_Season|2017 LSPL Spring Season]] Suning Gaming finished the regular split 2nd with 17 wins and 5 losses. They won the playoffs with a 3-0 sweep over [[Young Miracles]]. Suning also participated in the [[Demacia Cup/2017 Season|2017 Demacia Cup]] but didn't go far and finished 9th-12th with a 1-2 loss to [[I May]]. After they qualified for the LPL, Suning Gaming finished the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|2017 LPL Summer Season]] 4th in their group with a 7-9 record. Their playoffs run was short lived as they got swept 0-3 in the first round by [[Invictus Gaming]]. With this loss Suning Gaming's season ended.

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed "狼行" ("Wolf Walking"), which is short for his ID '''狼行天下''' ("Wolf Walking Around World") on the Chinese server.
** His ID '''Langx''' is short for "Lang Xing" (狼行).
* His former ID '''XiaoAL''' stands for "Xiao A-Li" (小阿黎), which comes from the family name of his former girlfriend.
